claims.value: Vaudoncourt distinguishes National Guards restricted to internal service from a usable defense component of 100 gunners, 30 soldiers and 5 gendarmes (135 by our arithmetic); the next page instead says 130 besieged by nearly 24,000. claims.rationale: Interested French retrospective with mismatched arithmetic. No 130/24,000 ratio adopted, and not equated to Bodart/Plotho’s total garrison. Original national returns uninspected. English rendering (ours): "The few National Guards who entered could only serve internally; available for defense remained one hundred gunners, thirty soldiers and five gendarmes. The next page: one hundred thirty were besieged by nearly twenty-four thousand."
